content.title: The Best Wrongful Death Lawyers in CT
content.text: When the worst has happened, and you aren’t getting the answers you want, it may be time to contact a Connecticut wrongful death lawyer. If you believe you’ve lost a loved one due to another party’s negligence, a personal injury lawyer can advise on whether you have a viable case to build. No settlement can replace the irreplaceable, but rightful compensation can help pay for funeral expenses and cover your costs of living while you take the steps to heal. These top wrongful death attorneys offer trusted, compassionate care, and one could be right to represent you. Adelman, Connors & Krevolin, LLP The wrongful death attorneys at Adelman, Connors & Krevolin have extensive knowledge and experience representing clients who’ve lost loved ones due to medical malpractice errors, car accidents, and faulty products. The firm has recovered millions for its clients from hospitals, medical providers, and large corporations like General Motors. The trial team comprises strong negotiators who provide compassionate, individualized service to its clients. They only take on cases they believe can win and are prepared to take all necessary actions to recover maximum compensation when you lose a loved one. Visit their website Aeton Law Partners In Connecticut, a wrongful death claim is a lawsuit that states an accident or injury was the cause of someone’s death. An experienced CT wrongful death lawyer at Aeton Law Partners can help you determine the validity of your wrongful death claim, whether your loved one was fatally injured due to a car accident, medical malpractice, someone’s malicious intent, or another act of negligence. The firm offers free consultations, and if you decide to work together on your wrongful death claim, your personal injury lawyer will educate and guide you through every step of the process. Brickley Law Ann Brickley has an extensive law practice that helps injured parties and their families, including filing wrongful death claims. Her firm has experience and knowledge in pursuing compensation for lost wages, funeral costs, loss of companionship, and more. Anytime an injury leads to death, there may be a viable wrongful death claim. The Brickley Law website outlines who can be sued for wrongful death, including an at-fault party in a motor vehicle collision, companies who release unsafe products, property owners who fail to implement proper safety protocols, and medical professionals guilty of medical malpractice. Visit their website Cooper Law Group Connecticut wrongful death lawyer Jeffrey Cooper has recovered millions of dollars for families whose loved ones died in an accident or due to medical malpractice. He only accepts clients with cases he believes he can win, so once Cooper becomes your Connecticut wrongful death lawyer, you know he’s serious about your claim. Attorney Cooper has a robust personal injury practice, giving him a firm grasp on the laws surrounding negligence, accidents, and injuries, including fatalities. He offers a free consultation, takes cases contingently, and provides every client with accessible, communicative legal support. Visit their website Edwards Trial Law If your loved one was in a catastrophic car accident or fatal medical malpractice incident, Edwards Trial Law can help. Attorney Paul T. Edwards’ practice focuses on catastrophic and wrongful death cases, plus he has twenty-five years of experience and expertise. His website shares critical information about what to do even moments after an accident occurs, plus he has over a decade of experience defending hospitals and medical professionals; if your loved one’s death resulted from an accident or medical malpractice, this Connecticut wrongful death attorney can help best position your claim. Visit their website Ganim Injury Lawyers Ganim Injury Lawyers represent executors and surviving family members of deceased parties in wrongful death claims and probate court, a necessary part of the process once a settlement is awarded. If your loved one suffered fatal injuries in a car or motorcycle accident, from medical malpractice, or any other intentional or negligent act, George Ganim Jr., Esq. has the knowledge and experience to represent you. This Connecticut wrongful death attorney will seek damages for your loved one’s pain and suffering before their death, medical expenses, lost wages and future earning capacity, funeral expenses, and more. Visit their website Jacobs & Wallace, PLLC Although most doctors do their best to provide quality healthcare services, there are times when negligence or carelessness results in illness, injury, or death. If you believe this caused your loved one’s death, you may want to contact Jacobs & Wallace about a medical malpractice wrongful death claim. Some of the wrongful death attorneys at this firm have past experience representing the insurance companies they now hold accountable for damages caused by medical malpractice, giving them direct insight into their opposition. From misdiagnoses to surgical errors, Jacobs & Wallace can help get you justice and fair compensation. Visit their website Kennedy, Johnson, Schwab and Roberge The wrongful death attorneys at Kennedy, Johnson, Schwab & Roberge have extensive experience representing families that have lost a loved one due to negligence. They have a track record of successfully holding negligent parties accountable, resulting in multi-million dollar settlements for their clients. Wrongful death cases are taken on a contingency basis, meaning you’ll incur no legal fees unless a settlement is awarded to you. This firm has won wrongful death cases for disease misdiagnosis, botched surgeries that led to death, and hospital negligence, among others. Visit their website Suisman Shapiro, Attorneys At Law Clients of Suisman Shapiro benefit from their team of resourceful wrongful death attorneys who are determined to file claims against all responsible parties. The firm’s website states that many times, surviving family members may not be aware of the damages they’re entitled to or who is responsible to compensate them. These personal injury lawyers skillfully represent to juries the total impact a loss has on surviving family members — financially, emotionally, and beyond. They take wrongful death claims due to all types of negligence, auto accidents, birth injuries, medical malpractice, and premises and product liability. Visit their website The Reardon Law Firm The wrongful death of a loved one is an especially painful experience, and the CT wrongful death attorneys at The Reardon Law Firm promise you personalized, attentive legal services. The firm has a track record of successfully recovering damages for a wrongful death claim against individuals, small businesses, large corporations, and other entities. If your loved one was involved in a boating or railroad crossing accident, aircraft crash, or any other negligent incident that led to their death, the best Connecticut wrongful death lawyer for you may be here. Visit their website Williams, Walsh & O'Connor, LLC Williams, Walsh & O’Connor understands the emotional impact a catastrophic loss has on a family and how a successful wrongful death claim can offer closure and support through life’s most difficult challenges. Money can never replace a family member, but the financial strain of lost income can be devastating. In many cases, the investigative justice of a wrongful death case helps family members understand and come to terms with what went wrong. They’ve recovered millions of dollars for families of deceased defendants and offer a free consultation for those who think they may be entitled to similar rightful compensation. Visit their website MORE nearby with great reviews Find other highly-rated firms and practices in CT fast and easily. How To Advertise FAQs Who can sue for wrongful death in Connecticut? Only the executor of a deceased person’s estate in Connecticut can file a wrongful death claim. If no executor was appointed before the time of death, or in the event the executor isn’t capable of serving, the court may appoint an executor who is then able to sue for wrongful death and is also responsible for tying up the loose ends of the deceased’s estate. (Nolo) What are the elements of wrongful death? A CT wrongful death lawyer can build a case based on the following elements: a person’s death was caused by another’s negligence or malicious intent, the surviving family is suffering financial hardship due to their loved one’s death, and a representative of the deceased’s estate has been appointed. (FindLaw) If you believe you have a wrongful death case, one of the top wrongful death attorneys on this list can help. Who gets the money in a wrongful death lawsuit? The court can award damages to the deceased’s estate in a Connecticut wrongful death lawsuit, as the executor of the estate is the only party entitled to sue for wrongful death. However, other legal options exist for spouses to sue for lost wages, support, and companionship. An experienced CT wrongful death lawyer can guide you through the best course of action for you. What is the average settlement for wrongful death? Every wrongful death claim is unique, so there is no average amount plaintiffs can expect based on past verdicts and settlements. In a wrongful death lawsuit, the court considers the deceased’s income at the time of their death and calculates the approximate monetary value they could have earned in years to come. Settlements can also include funds to cover funeral expenses, medical expenses before death, the amount of pain and suffering the person endured before their life ended, and additional spousal settlements for the loss of consortium. Loss of consortium is what happens when an injured spouse can no longer give their partner the love, companionship, comfort, services, support, or intimate relations that they provided after an accident or death occurred. What is the statute of limitations for wrongful death in Connecticut? Filing a wrongful death claim in Connecticut has to be within two years of the date of the person’s death and no more than five years after the incident or accident that led to their death.
